description: Opened 2023 in Royal Complex as cafe-and-sourdough-bakery: pale, airy, minimal, with a visible bread counter and good specialty coffee. A July 2026 laptop-work roundup pick; freelancers camp here. Full breakfast, sandwiches, pasta, desserts. Fills up on weekends. Open 9:00-24:00.
